_comment: More ways to give to the maintainer directly. Like the Patreon route in data/donate/routes.json, money sent through any of these goes to the maintainer personally (not to the nonprofit Sponsor-a-Can) and is NOT tax-deductible; the Donate page says so above the list. Patreon moved to routes.json on 2026-10-04, when the operator named it as THE direct link 'for the time being'; these three are the handles he added on 2026-07-13, each checked with a plain HTTP request on 2026-10-04 (all 200). Read by BOTH the web donate page (fetch /data/donate/methods.json, merged + de-duped into the grid) AND native donate.rs (load_donate_methods -> build_donation_sources). Add a method = add an object here; no code change (infinite-of-X). Crypto addresses are handled separately (the server's funding config), not listed here.

methods.label: Recurring or one-time sponsorship via GitHub.
